changelog: **Session agendas — the data model (#1841):** four additive models. `AgendaTemplate` + `AgendaTemplateItem` are the tenant's reusable, trilingual guided-conversation library (the `ProjectTaskTemplate` shape: canonical `title`/`prompt` as dedupe key and fallback, `translations` JSON per locale, `useCount`, `archivedAt` retire-not-delete, `@@unique([orgId, title])`; `programId` is a plain nullable id until #1622 lands). `SessionAgenda` + `SessionAgendaItem` are the per-session instance a pair works through, hanging off `MentorshipRelation` and optionally the `Meeting` it was held in (`meetingId @unique`, `templateId` SetNull so retiring a template never blanks a held session, `carriedFromItemId` for carry-over). `AgendaTemplate` is in `TENANT_MODELS`; `SessionAgenda` carries the "reached through a scoped parent" comment. `src/lib/agendas.ts` (+ dependency-free `agendasRule.ts`) mirrors `goalTemplates.ts`: `resolveItemText` reads a templated item live from the template in the reader's locale, falling back to the default locale, then the canonical string; `instantiateAgenda()` creates a session from a template and bumps `useCount`. `prisma/seed-agenda-templates.mjs` seeds six trilingual starter conversations (kickoff, goal-setting, mid-point review, career, feedback, closing) idempotently and runs on deploy next to `seed-goal-templates`. Schema, resolver and seeder only — the agenda panel and `/admin/agenda-templates` are #1843.

en: Groundwork for session agendas: the data model and a six-conversation starter library (kickoff, goal-setting, mid-point review, career, feedback, closing) in English, Turkish and German. The agenda panel itself follows.
tr: Oturum gündemleri için altyapı: veri modeli ve İngilizce, Türkçe, Almanca altı başlangıç konuşması (tanışma, hedef belirleme, ara değerlendirme, kariyer, geri bildirim, kapanış). Gündem paneli bir sonraki adımda geliyor.
de: Grundlage für Sitzungsagenden: das Datenmodell und eine Startbibliothek mit sechs Gesprächen (Auftakt, Ziele setzen, Zwischenbilanz, Karriere, Feedback, Abschluss) auf Englisch, Türkisch und Deutsch. Das Agenda-Panel selbst folgt.
